rows.title_full:
AN ACT
PROVIDING FOR A NEW PASSPORT LAW, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO.  8239, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “PHILIPPINE PASSPORT ACT OF 1996”
rows.abstract:
Aims to update and reflect current laws that affect the process of issuing passports.

Simplifies the passport documentation requirements by requiring the submission of specific documents; revises the list of persons entitled to diplomatic and official passports; provides for the issuance of passports with 5 or 10 year validity; imposes penalties against the persons who use or conspire and connive with other to use fraudulent passports.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2021-02-09, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-02-11 and received by the Senate on 2021-02-11

rows.abstract:

Aims therefore to amend Art. 867 so that Article 863 would correctly refer to Article 870 which provides the period limiting the prohibition on alienation to 20 years.

rows.author: J013
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES UNDER ARTICLE 217 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE ACT NO.3815, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the rampant graft and corruption in the country by increasing penalties imposed for malversation of public funds.

Proposes to upgrade such penalties by moving up the periods of the divisible penalties provided in article 217 of the Revised Penal Code from prision mayor in its minimum to medium periods to prision mayor in its medium and maximum periods.

Intends to make the penalty of reclusion perpetua imposable to a lower amount from P8,800,000.00 to P4,400,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2021-02-01

rows.author: J013
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES UNDER THE ANTI-GRAFT AND CORRUPT PRACTICES ACT, AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3019,AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Seeks to increase the maximum penalty for violations of Sections 3, 4, 5, and 6 of R.A. No. 3019 to TWENTY (20) YEARS to mirror the maximum period for reclusion temporal, while the imposable fine or imprisonment for failure to submit one´s STATEMENT OF ASSETS, LIABILITIES and NET WORTH (SALN)  will be increased to “a fine of NOT LESS THAN TEN THOUSAND PESOS (P10,000.00) nor more than ONE HUNDRED THOUSAND PESOS (P100,000.00), or by imprisonment not exceeding FIVE YEARS, or by both such fine and imprisonment, at the discretion of the Court. 
Provides that such upgrade of penalties for violations as provided in R.A. No. 3019 is as follows:
Sec. 3 - Corrupt practices of public officers; Sec. 4 - Prohibition on private individuals (with a close personal relationship with any public official); Sec. 5 - Prohibition on certain relatives; Sec. 6 - Prohibition on Members of Congress.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2021-02-01

rows.author: H058
rows.title_full:
AN ACT
PROVIDING FOR A MANDATORY IMMUNIZATION PROGRAM, REPEALING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10152, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “MANDATORY INFANTS AND CHILDREN HEALTH IMMUNIZATION ACT OF 2011”
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish a National Immunization Program under the Department of Health (DOH), which shall ensure that the population is equitably protected from vaccine-preventable diseases such as Tuberculosis, Diphtheria, Tetanus And Pertussis, Poliomyelitis, Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Hepatitis-B, Human Influenza Type-B, Rotavirus, Japanese Encephalitis, Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccine (PCV), Human Papilloma Virus (HPV), and booster for Measles, Rubella, Tetanus, Diphtheria ( MRTD) and such other types as may be determined by the Secretary of Health.

Mandates PhilHealth to include the mandatory immunization services specified under this Act in its benefit package.

Creates the National Immunization Technical and Advisory Group (NITAG) that shall serve as a technical and independent multi-disciplinary advisory body to provide evidence-based policy and program decisions on immunization and vaccines to the DOH.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2021-02-08, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-02-09 and received by the Senate on 2021-02-09

Intends to correct the inconsistency of Article 737 with Article 734, in some cases which states that “the donation is perfected from the moment the donor knows of the acceptance by the donee.”

“Article 737. [The donor´s capacity shall be determined as of the time of the making of the donation] AT THE TIME THE DONATION IS PERFECTED, BOTH OF THE DONOR AND THE DONEE MUST BE CAPACITATED.
